title: 4th string: D, E and F
summary: Three notes at the bottom of the staff.

steps.title: Below the staff
text: The open 4th string is **D**, hanging just below the bottom line.
**E** is on the bottom line, at the 2nd fret. **F** is in the first space, at the 3rd fret.

steps.title: Second and third fingers
text: The frets are open, 2 and 3, so use your 2nd and 3rd fingers. The small number beside each note is the finger, and here it matches the fret.

steps.title: Up and back
text: Say the note names as you play. These notes ring longer than the high ones, so let each one last its full length.
